mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, we have clear skies at Verona Area High School, a First Quarter moon, and the ISS will be visible rising over Mount Horeb at 4:55 AM, traveling high in the sky toward Fitchburg.

The city is currently working on the Mark Drive reconstruction project, which includes new water and sewer lines and new sidewalks. Additionally, the city is committed to a long-term goal of improving connectivity with a new policy for installing sidewalks and multi-use paths.

There is a lot happening today, including the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market, yoga at Insight Wellness, and Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory. Looking ahead, you can enjoy Concerts in the Park tomorrow.
On Friday, August 15, a 29-year-old man was arrested for his second O W I offence after a citizen reported him for reckless driving.
Today's flavor of the day is the sweet and refreshing Double Strawberry. The store is currently closed but will open at 10 AM. If you miss out, tomorrow's flavor will be Chocolate Heath Crunch.
